errors.code_expired: That code has expired. Start over to have a new one sent.
errors.email_invalid: That email address doesn't look right. Check it and try again.
errors.flood_wait: Telegram has asked us to slow down. Try again in about {wait}.
errors.no_account: This number has no Telegram account yet. Create one in the Telegram app, then sign in here.
errors.no_answer: Telegram didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.no_api_credentials: No Telegram API credentials in this build. Add TG_API_ID and TG_API_HASH to local.properties and rebuild.
errors.no_space: This device has run out of storage. Free up some space, then try again.
errors.offline: Can't reach Telegram. Check this device's internet connection.
errors.phone_invalid: That number isn't one Telegram recognises. Include the country code, as in +44.
errors.premium_sign_in: Telegram won't send this number a code here. Sign in with a QR code from the Telegram app instead: start over, then choose Scan a QR code.
errors.signed_out: Telegram signed this device out. Sign in again to carry on.
errors.tdlib_unavailable: TDLib, the part of TMPlayer Music that talks to Telegram, could not start on this device. Please report this with the message: {message}
errors.unsupported_sign_in_step: This account needs a step TMPlayer Music can't do. Finish signing in in the Telegram app first, then try again.

login.choose_body: Play the audio files already in your own Telegram chats. Sign in to pick the chats with your music.
login.code_body_app: Telegram sent the code to the Telegram app on your other device.
login.phone_body: Include the country code, as in +44 7700 900123.
login.qr_body: On your phone, open Telegram, go to Settings, then Devices, then Link Desktop Device, and scan this code.
login.stalled: This is taking longer than usual. Check the connection, then try again.

shell.next_step: Picking the chats with your music comes next.
